title: Original LSTM-8, frozen original code
hypothesis: Reproduces last semester's baseline (with fixed seeds).
subjects: YES JM EG IES CH HM
result_summary: Reproduces last semester (YES -0.49 seed0 R2 -0.68 and JM -0.64 -0.32, identical to report-1 original-settings runs). Problematic positions fail mainly by OFFSET (54-72% of MSE), predictions follow push timing (corr 0.80-0.97), no misalignment. Large seed-to-seed spread (YES -0.49: -0.68/-0.26/-1.80).
reason: Official reproduction; experiments compare against X00f (same code path).
limitations: Training is chaotic: 1e-6 numeric differences change the result (X00 vs X00f).

title: LSTM-8 baseline run through the experiment framework
hypothesis: Reproduces X00 (frozen original code) exactly; used as the reference for every experiment and for the S2→S1 direction.
motivation: Needed so that every experiment differs from the baseline in one thing only.
subjects: YES JM EG IES CH HM
result_summary: Data identical to X00 (check_equivalence.py); training not bit-identical (rounding 1e-6) -> differs at run-to-run level.

title: Clean passive table (static holds only)
hypothesis: The original passive table accepted pieces of passive trials that were not relaxed (JM: +11.7 Nm entry). Using only the still, steady holds removes that labelling error; it should fix JM at −0.08 rad and change nothing elsewhere.
motivation: Diagnosis of the passive table (bug found in report 1, re-checked this semester). Supervisor: passive torque must come from the passive trials.
result_summary: JM -0.078 rad: R2 -54.9 -> 0.58, RMSE 12.5 -> 1.08 Nm (-91%); other positions within run-to-run noise.
reason: Corrects a labelling error in the original passive table (non-relaxed pieces accepted by the 20 Nm rule). No-op for YES/EG/CH/HM/IES.
limitations: 2 seeds; criteria table not applicable (fix targets a non-plantarflexed position).

title: Dropout 0.0 (baseline 0.3)
hypothesis: If the baseline is over-regularised (underfits), less dropout improves the weak positions.
reason: Problematic-position R2 did not improve (Stage A, YES+EG, 2 seeds); see report.

title: Dropout 0.1 (baseline 0.3)
reason: Problematic-position R2 did not improve (Stage A, YES+EG, 2 seeds); see report.

title: Dropout 0.5 (baseline 0.3)
hypothesis: If the baseline overfits session 1, more dropout improves generalisation to session 2.
reason: Problematic-position R2 did not improve (Stage A, YES+EG, 2 seeds); see report.

title: Learning rate 0.001 (baseline 0.003)
hypothesis: If training is unstable (large run-to-run differences), a smaller learning rate gives more stable and better solutions.
motivation: Optimisation check; baseline runs disagreed strongly for JM.
result_summary: Stage A (matched seeds 0-1): -0.009. Stage B: 0.156->0.425 but RMSE only -0.19 Nm; regressions at YES -0.28/-0.18.
reason: Fails regression (15.004% > 15%) and noise criteria; small Nm gain.

title: Every position counts the same in the fit (divide each position by its typical swing)
hypothesis: Plain least squares in Nm² lets the strong positions dominate (YES: 2 most plantarflexed positions = 1 % of the loss). Dividing each position's target by its training standard deviation (= weighted least squares, weight 1/σ²) should improve the plantarflexed positions without hurting the others much.
motivation: Loss-imbalance diagnosis; inverse-variance weighting of task losses (Kendall et al. 2018).
result_summary: Stage A (matched seeds 0-1): +0.087 (fails rule 1). Stage B (3 seeds): 0.156->0.420, RMSE -0.67 Nm; YES +0.03 RMSE +36%.
decision: trade-off; combined in C01 by judgment (not per rules)
reason: Fails regression criterion (YES +0.03) and noise criterion.

title: EMG auto-gain (running per-muscle rescaling, off for people who push both ways)
hypothesis: The EMG size for the same push changes between sessions (JM ≈ 0.4–0.5× at some positions). Rescaling each muscle by its own recent quiet and strong levels should make session 2 look like session 1.
motivation: EMG amplitude depends on electrode contact, sweat, temperature (De Luca 1997); running normalisation used before (Tanaka et al. 2022).
result_summary: Stage A (matched seeds 0-1): +0.183, fails only noise rule. Stage B: 0.156->0.297, RMSE -0.63 Nm; reverse direction -0.06 (YES -0.49 worse).
decision: not confirmed by rules; combined in C01 by judgment
reason: Fails noise criterion and reverse-direction sign because of YES -0.49.

title: 0.4 s input window (baseline 0.2 s)
hypothesis: A longer history gives the model more context for small, slow pushes.
motivation: Longer windows (~300–600 ms) used for EMG-based estimation (Wang H et al. 2024).
reason: Problematic-position R2 did not improve (Stage A, YES+EG, 2 seeds); see report.

title: Auto-gain + equal weight per position
hypothesis: X05 and X04 address different causes (EMG size change; loss imbalance); may add up.
result_summary: 0.156->0.407, RMSE -0.77 Nm (best), other positions max +4%; EG -0.74 0.96-0.97 all seeds both directions; YES -0.49 worse.
reason: Meets rules 1-3 vs X00f but fails 4 and the reverse-direction sign; vs X05 fails noise rule; vs X04 -0.013. Chosen by judgment (lowest RMSE, no large regression).

title: Passive-trial value as extra input
hypothesis: The resting level of the passive-trial key shifts between sessions (YES -0.49: 0.72 Nm vs 0.40 Nm std, R2 ceiling -2.3). Knowing each trial's passive-trial value may let the model predict that shift.
result_summary: Seeds 0-1, YES+EG: 0.344->0.53; improves YES -0.49 (as does X03); other positions up to +197% RMSE (YES +0.245 reverse).
reason: Fails regression criterion badly (+149% RMSE); not combined (Stage C rule).
limitations: 2 seeds; a restricted version (only where passive value is small) would be a post-hoc hack.

title: Clean passive + auto-gain + equal weight
subjects: JM IES CH HM (YES, EG = C01)
result_summary: vs official X00 (S1toS2): toes-down 0.706->0.926 on JM IES CH HM (8/8), all 6: 0.50->0.77, RMSE 1.13->0.56 Nm; other positions 0.87->0.97. YES -0.49 worse. Regressions: RMSE up to +32% at some strong positions (R2 change <=0.035).
decision: final candidate chosen by judgment; not confirmed by the pre-registered rules
reason: Meets criteria 1-2 on unseen subjects; fails 3 (15% RMSE tolerance at 2-3 strong positions, R2 change <= 0.035) and 4 in the primary direction (passes 4 in reverse).
limitations: YES -0.49 offset ceiling; same-visit sessions; 3 seeds.
